settle the bill: After dinner, my father asked the waiter to bring the check so he could settle the bill.
晚餐後，爸爸請服務生拿帳單來，好讓他結帳。
settle down: After traveling around the world for years, she wanted to settle down and buy a small house.
環遊世界多年後，她想安頓下來，買一間小房子。
settle for less: Don't settle for less than you deserve; keep looking until you find a job you truly love.
別將就接受低於你應得的條件；繼續找，直到找到你真正喜愛的工作。
settle one's nerves: Before the speech contest, she took a few deep breaths to settle her nerves.
演講比賽前，她深呼吸幾次來鎮定神經。
settle in a city: Many young people from the countryside hope to settle in a city like Taipei to find better jobs.
許多來自鄉下的年輕人希望定居城市，例如台北，以找到更好的工作。
the dust settles: Let's wait until the dust settles after the election before we make any big decisions.
我們等選舉後塵埃落定，再做任何重大決定吧。
sew up a deal: After one final meeting, the two companies managed to sew up a deal before the holiday.
在最後一次會議後，兩家公司在假期前成功敲定交易。
sew a button: My grandmother taught me how to sew a button back onto my school shirt with a needle.
奶奶教我怎麼縫扣子，用針把它縫回制服上。
sew up the election: With a huge lead in every poll, the mayor expects to sew up the election easily next month.
市長在每項民調都大幅領先，預料下個月的選舉將穩操勝券。
sew up a wound: The doctor needed ten stitches to sew up a wound on the boy's knee after he fell.
男孩跌倒後，醫生縫了十針來縫合傷口。
shade one's eyes: She raised her hand to shade her eyes from the bright sun while looking for her friends on the beach.
她舉起手遮住眼睛擋住刺眼的陽光，一邊在海灘上找朋友。
shade into: In the evening sky, the bright orange slowly shades into deep purple and then dark blue.
傍晚的天空中，明亮的橘色慢慢漸變為深紫色，然後變成深藍色。
shades of meaning: Advanced learners must understand the small shades of meaning between words like "thin" and "slim."
進階學習者必須了解像 thin 和 slim 這類字詞之間意義的細微差別。
throw shade: Some fans love it when singers throw shade at each other in interviews, but I find it rude.
有些粉絲很愛看歌手在訪談中互相暗諷，但我覺得很沒禮貌。
put in the shade: Her brilliant performance tonight put in the shade everyone who had sung before her.
她今晚精彩的表演，使在她之前唱過的每個人都黯然失色。
shadow a doctor: As part of her medical training, she will shadow a doctor at the hospital for two weeks.
作為醫學訓練的一部分，她將在醫院跟隨醫生見習兩週。
shadow a suspect: Two police officers in plain clothes were ordered to shadow a suspect through the busy night market.
兩名便衣警察奉命在熱鬧的夜市裡跟蹤嫌犯。
a shadow of one's former self: After years of illness, the once-famous boxer was thin, weak, and just a shadow of his former self.
多年病痛後，這位曾經著名的拳擊手又瘦又虛弱，真是今非昔比。
beyond a shadow of a doubt: The video proved beyond a shadow of a doubt that the man had stolen the bike.
這段影片毫無疑問地證明那名男子偷了腳踏車。
shake the market: News of the sudden war began to shake the market, and stock prices fell sharply within hours.
突如其來的戰爭消息開始震撼市場，股價在幾小時內大幅下跌。
shake one's confidence: Failing the first test did not shake her confidence; she studied even harder for the next one.
第一次考試不及格並沒有讓她動搖信心；她為下一次考試更加努力讀書。
shake off a cold: I drank lots of hot tea and went to bed early, hoping to shake off a cold before the exam.
我喝了很多熱茶並早早上床睡覺，希望在考試前擺脫感冒。
shake hands: At the end of the game, players from both teams shake hands to show respect.
比賽結束時，兩隊球員會握手以表示尊重。
shake up the company: The new CEO promised to shake up the company by cutting old rules and hiring young talent.
新任執行長承諾要重組公司，刪除舊規定並雇用年輕人才。
shake one's head: If you don't agree with the answer, just shake your head and the teacher will call on someone else.
如果你不同意這個答案，只要搖頭，老師就會叫別人回答。
shake with fear: The little girl began to shake with fear when she heard the thunder outside her window.
小女孩聽到窗外的雷聲，開始怕得發抖。
shake off the pursuer: The thief ran into a crowded market to shake off the pursuer who was chasing him.
小偷跑進擁擠的市場，想甩開正在追他的追兵。
shape the future: Good teachers help shape the future by inspiring young people to dream big and work hard.
好老師激勵年輕人勇於夢想、努力奮鬥，藉此幫助塑造未來。
shape one's character: Playing team sports helped shape his character and taught him how to accept defeat.
參加團隊運動幫助他塑造品格，也教會他如何接受失敗。
shape public opinion: Social media now plays a huge role in shaping public opinion about politicians and important issues.
社群媒體如今在影響輿論方面扮演重要角色，左右人們對政治人物和重大議題的看法。
shape up: If you don't shape up and start doing your homework, you will fail this class.
如果你不改進、不開始寫作業，這門課你會被當。
in good shape: Although the car is ten years old, it is still in good shape because he takes care of it.
雖然這輛車已經十年了，但因為他很愛惜，所以仍然狀態良好。
take shape: After months of planning, our plans for the school festival are finally starting to take shape.
經過數月的籌備，我們的校慶計畫終於開始成形。
shape policy: Experts were invited to help shape policy on climate change and clean energy for the next ten years.
專家受邀協助制定政策，規劃未來十年的氣候變遷與綠能方向。
